package.name: curobo_task_constructor
package.description: An open MoveIt Task Constructor equivalent for cuRobo: a stage/container framework (generators / propagators / connectors composed into serial, alternatives, fallbacks and independent containers) with cuRobo's batched GPU solve as the execution substrate. Planning is local (in-process, like MoveIt: core.Task.plan() publishes introspection itself). The action server at /curobo_task_constructor/execute_task_solution fronts MTC ExecuteTaskSolution: it drives a full Solution message's sub-trajectories in order with no replanning.
